scope.role: post-P2-SEL exposed D-dev-select development diagnosis only
scope.scientific_question: Why does E produce a small damaging ZH-correct false-positive tail and miss EN-confusion positions, and can one frozen reference-free repair improve the precision/recall tradeoff?

frozen_intervention.gradient: existing p2dir_readout_v1 zero-leaf autograd.grad; float64 tangent projection and normalization; float32 return
frozen_intervention.localizer: unchanged max_attention_window 50 frames (1.0 s), maximum current-query frozen alignment-head mass, earliest tie

probabilities.provider: existing native_lid; softmax over exactly the frozen 100 Whisper language-token logits, then read the EN/ZH entries
probabilities.null_input: exact zero waveform, 30 seconds at 16 kHz
probabilities.Q_semantics: absolute probability mass assigned to the EN/ZH pair; valid range [0,1], not constrained to 1

short_window.bounds: for selected [s0,s1), a=clamp(floor((s0+s1-8000)/2),0,heard_samples-8000), crop [a,a+8000); if heard_samples<8000, use [0,heard_samples)
short_window.score: same native_lid, same null correction, same E formula

localizer_scalars: selected window start/end frames and samples
existing evaluator timing error where present

temporal.source: all current steps in existing P2-R run3 trace
temporal.E_lag_1: previous absolute query E; zero if no previous row
temporal.E_lag_2: two-previous absolute query E; zero if no previous row

oracle.source: existing P2-R run3 acoustic.E_oracle and timing_error_sec for EN-confusion targets only

by_stratum_and_failure_group: distinct dialogue IDs and count per dialogue
summaries.bootstrap: 10000 shared paired dialogue draws over fixed 20-dialogue universe; seed 240924; percentile 90% interval; resample dialogue clusters and retain all rows; for rates use equal dialogue weighting, omit empty dialogue-stratum cells, require >=9900 valid draws; same draws for H_E2 persistent-rate difference

global_Q_reference.source: already-exposed P0-R2 prerun audit pair_mass across 5082 rows in 67 files

H_E1.static_scale_pattern: at least 4/5 ZH FP have E_short<=0.10 and E_long-E_short>=0.25; at least 34/42 EN TP have E_short>=0.20; each group spans at least 3 dialogues
H_E1.oracle_FN_pattern: at least 9/18 EN FN have existing E_oracle>=0.20 and E_oracle-E_long>=0.20; at least 3 dialogues
H_E1.short_only_FN_pattern: at least 9/18 EN FN have E_short>=0.20 while E_long=0; at least 3 dialogues
H_E1.pass: any one pattern; oracle_FN_pattern or short_only_FN_pattern routes LOCALIZER_PRIMARY; otherwise static_scale_pattern routes R2

H_E2.pass: at least 4/5 ZH FP isolated across >=3 dialogues; at least 26/42 EN TP persistent across >=3 dialogues; one-sided 80% paired dialogue-bootstrap lower bound for EN-TP persistent rate minus ZH-FP persistent rate >0

H_E3.name: low EN/ZH pair-confidence artifact
H_E3.q_low_source: already-exposed P0-R2 global pair_mass 10th percentile; frozen before E0

pass_criteria.bootstrap_draws: 20 dialogue IDs sampled with replacement; shared between groups
pass_criteria.dialogue_rate: within each draw, mean group-specific low-Q proportion over represented dialogues equally; omit empty group cells

H_E3.not_automatic: global Q variation alone is insufficient; require FP/TP enrichment, contrast, dialogue support and lower bound

H_E4.pass: at least 4/5 ZH FP have ell_local<=0, A>0, null_share>=0.80 across >=3 dialogues; median ell_local among EN TP >0

repair_formulas.R1_temporal: E_new_t=E_t*max(E_lag_1,E_lag_2); missing lags are zero; no future values
repair_formulas.R3_confidence: E_new_t=E_t*Q_local_t; no threshold, fitted coefficient, or extra hyperparameter
repair_formulas.R5_localizer_primary: stop before E1; no formula or steering

precedence: H_E1 internal: LOCALIZER_PRIMARY for oracle_FN_pattern or short_only_FN_pattern; else R2 for static_scale_pattern

integrity.language_id_source: model generation_config.lang_to_id; sorted unique integer values
integrity.mapping_digest_encoding: UTF-8 JSON of sorted [[language_token, integer_id], ...] pairs with separators (",", ":") and no whitespace
integrity.null_provider: native_lid on an all-zero float32 waveform of 480000 samples at 16 kHz
integrity.mapping_digest_algorithm: sha256(UTF8(json.dumps(sorted((str(language),int(id)) for language,id in lang_to_id.items()), separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False)))

requires: one selected repair R1, R2, or R4
E1.reuse_old: reuse P2-SEL C0/C2 only after exact key, state, direction, hook, alpha, site, NormPreserve and evaluator hash verification; otherwise rerun C_old in the single E1 job
E1.new_job: only C_new pulse when reusable C0/C_old pass audit; no other arm/search
metrics: realized squared post-NormPreserve edit energy by stratum
descriptive outcomes on historical 5 ZH-FP and 18 EN-FN rows

thresholds.corruption_CI_note: 90% familywise upper bound 0.10 is development-only for dialogue-clustered n=60; observed cap remains 0.05 and this does not authorize deployment/confirmation

E2.AUTO: omit unless exact compatible cached output already exists; never regenerate for this stage
E2.interpretation: descriptive development mini-screen only; no pass label; no 300-utterance run or P3 authorization

audit.pre_E0: CPU pre-run audit verifies hashes, P2-SEL terminal status, exact population, P2-R trace joins, D2 seal, two-way Q provider, mini-panel, no E-stage outcomes, and data firewall
audit.post_E0: independent recomputation of probabilities, E identity, group counts/dialogues, lag joins, hypothesis predicates, precedence and selected formula; must not import primary decision module
audit.pre_E1: requires E0 audit PASS and exactly one eligible branch; verifies old/C0 reuse lineage
audit.post_E1: independently recompute energy, margins, corruption, bootstrap, label; must not import primary decision module
audit.pre_E2: requires E1 support and audit PASS plus exact mini-panel hash

compute.E0: CPU/artifact analysis; at most one small MIG GPU job for missing probabilities and attention scalars
compute.E1: at most one MIG GPU job
compute.E2: at most one conditional MIG GPU job

firewall.evaluator_oracle_timing: diagnostic only in E0; forbidden from E_new runtime inputs

contract_revision.reason: native_lid uses all 100 Whisper language IDs; Q is EN/ZH pair mass, not a normalized two-way posterior

tests: 100-way provider identity and exact language-ID mapping hash
Q equals P_E+P_M and accepts valid values in [0,1]
recomputed current E matches P2-R/P2-SEL E within 1e-6
E_new provider does not accept reference/evaluator features
H_E3 deterministic fixed-global-q10 decision and dialogue support
